author: Eric Blaisdell
title: Montpelier Police Log: Christmas Day caller goes overboard | Local News | timesargus.com
text:
The following is a sampling of calls to Montpelier police in recent days:
Dec. 22
An incident of road rage was reported on Berlin Street.
Property was lost on Main Street.
There was a suspicious event on Liberty Street. No further information was provided by police.
Dec. 23
On Main Street, a wallet was found and returned to its owner.
A debit card was lost downtown.
There was a two-vehicle crash on College Street at about 3:45 p.m. Minor injuries were reported.
A wallet was lost on Main Street.
Dec. 24
A vehicle was obstructing a plow truck on Terrace Street.
On Liberty Street, a car alarm was going off continuously.
A person was depositing snow into the roadway on Liberty Street.
On Elm Street, a vehicle broke down.
Dec. 25
A person called 911 about 111 times.
On Hill Street, an injured deer was reported.
There was an animal problem on Colonial Drive.
Dec. 26
A vehicle was parked on the sidewalk on Jay Street.
Vandalism was reported on Liberty Street.
There was a suspicious event on River Street. No further information was provided by police.
Dec. 27
Fraud was reported to the police department.
Trespassing was reported on Main Street.
There was a suspicious person on Main Street.
Dec. 28
A traffic hazard was reported on Berlin Street.
Fraud was reported on Pleasantview Street.
Items were stolen from a building on Northfield Street.
